tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Summarize the supplied snapshot and rule engine limits. Does not read the browser or Drive. Return snapshotToken for subsequent calls.

tools.name: evaluate_plan
tools.description: Evaluate date, closure, explicit conflict, duplication, weather and booking risks in the supplied snapshot. No minute-level transit solving.

tools.name: rank_candidates
tools.description: Rank plans for one trip date with the same deterministic formula as the web. Weather blocks require human review; canAssign covers structural rules.

tools.name: preview_changes
tools.description: Preview one assignment, moves, conflicting clears, lodging impact and new risks. Requires expectedSnapshotToken. Returns a proposal for web confirmation; never writes.
